Use case ui-mockup. Desktop screens wider than portrait phone screens; each phone has a 390x844 aspect. No hardware, perspective or photography. The attached image is the APPROVED VISUAL IDENTITY reference: carry over BLACK navigation with white humanist sans text, restrained YELLOW #FFCC00 current-task/action bands, WHITE evidence workspace, quiet gray rules, flat 2px rectangular controls. NO rebranding, new fonts, palette changes, gradients or decorative art. Change composition only as described below. Product is a usable listening tool, not a landing page. Preserve compact headings, zero letter spacing, 44px target intent, all controls legible.
EXACT content in every Practice: Jazz Ear Lab nav Practice / Insights / Legacy; M2 Recognition, Question 4 / 20, Stop in session header; C7; Which chord degree?; Your turn; Replay. Exactly 12 equally unselected answers in row-major order: 1, b9, 9, b3, 3, 11, #11, 5, b13, 13, b7, maj7. Desktop 6 columns x2 rows, phone 4x3. EXACT Insights: heading Insights and visible Example data label. READ-ONLY scope M2 Recognition / Context on / Previously seen / 18-24 Oct 2026 / All matching sessions. Root All and Quality 7 are the ONLY filter selectors. Main First-answer accuracy 70%, 28/40 assessed, 2 unassessed. SMALLER supporting text Replay-assisted 8/40; Correct-response median 2.4s, valid n=24. Scope then accuracy then patterns/action then details. Mobile may continue the second pattern below fold but primary action visible. ALL numbers illustrative.
COMPOSITION: A centered, constrained listening column rather than the reference's full-width left-aligned workspace. Desktop: compact black top nav, shallow yellow task strip containing exercise/progress/Stop, then centered C7 and prompt with substantial quiet white breathing room, modest centered Replay below status, then centered 6x2 degree grid at comfortable maximum width, with Session settings below. C7 is the focal point but not a giant hero. Mobile repeats exactly that centered stack and four-column answers; task strip wraps cleanly. Insights is a single centered evidence column with a clear left-aligned reading spine: compact read-only scope and Root/Quality row, dominant 70% with denominator immediately beside it, supporting replay/time in smaller text, then two wide pattern rows with modest yellow Customize focus next to 7/b7. Keep the content mostly white; yellow belongs to current task or explicit command, never whole sections, answer keys or every chart. No floating cards or sidebar. The same identity feels quieter by containing the task and balancing whitespace, not by shrinking controls.
